_note: The Fish-Boy: the angler's wrist computer, strapped to the left forearm (the hand toward +x). Its screen is the part "screen": one flat 192 x 108 mm rectangle (16:9) at z = 0 facing +z, with the anchor "screen" at its middle; the game draws the radar, the Fishpedia and the minigames on it. The bezel is 12 mm at the sides and 7 mm above and below, its front 3 mm proud of the screen, so a view that fits the screen to 80% of its width and height shows the bezel in the next 10% and the world in the last 10% (at a 50 degree field of view: 80%, 92%). The case hides behind the bezel there; the dial, the antenna, the knobs and the arm show at the edges. A tackle-box case: green with a cream stripe, brass rivets, a bobber dial, two knobs, three tab keys, a rod-tip antenna, a reel crank and a brass fish on the hand side. The sleeve takes the player's colour.
name: Fish-Boy
